1: // Asteroid Miner – concise canvas game
2: // Target canvas element with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // ---- Game state -----------------------------------------------------
12:   const ship = {
13:     x: 100,
14:     y: H / 2,
15:     angle: 0, // radians, 0 pointing right
16:     vx: 0,
17:     vy: 0,
18:     radius: 15,
19:     thrust: 0.2,
20:     turnSpeed: 0.07,
21:     fuel: 100,
22:   };
23: 
24:   const asteroids = [];
25:   const keys = {};
26:   let score = 0;
27:   let laser = false;
28:   let gameOver = false;
29: 
30:   // ---- Input ----------------------------------------------------------
31:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.code] = true);
32:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.code] = false);
33: 
34:   // ---- Helpers --------------------------------------------------------
35:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
36:   const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
37: 
38:   // ---- Game loop ------------------------------------------------------
39:   function update(dt) {
40:     if (gameOver) return;
41:     // Ship controls
42:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.turnSpeed;
43:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.turnSpeed;
44:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.fuel > 0) {
45:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
46:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
47:       ship.fuel -= 0.05; // consume fuel per thrust frame
48:     }
49:     laser = !!keys['Space'];
50: 
51:     // Apply inertia (simple drag)
52:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
53:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
54:     ship.x += ship.vx;
55:     ship.y += ship.vy;
56: 
57:     // Keep ship inside canvas (wrap horizontally, bounce vertically)
58:     if (ship.x > W) ship.x = 0;
59:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x = W;
60:     if (ship.y > H) ship.y = H;
61:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = 0;
62: 
63:     // Generate asteroids
64:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) {
65:       const size = rand(10, 30);
66:       asteroids.push({
67:         x: W + size,
68:         y: rand(0, H),
69:         radius: size,
70:         speed: rand(1, 3),
71:       });
72:     }
73: 
74:     // Update asteroids
75:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
76:       const a = asteroids[i];
77:       a.x -= a.speed;
78:       // Remove when off‑screen
79:       if (a.x + a.radius < 0) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
80:     }
81: 
82:     // Collision & mining
83:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
84:       const a = asteroids[i];
85:       const d = dist(ship, a);
86:       // Collision – end game
87:       if (d < ship.radius + a.radius) {
88:         gameOver = true;
89:         break;
90:       }
91:       // Mining laser
92:       if (laser && d < ship.radius + a.radius + 20) {
93:         score += Math.floor(a.radius);
94:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + a.radius * 0.2);
95:         // small explosion effect – just remove asteroid
96:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
97:       }
98:     }
99: 
100:     // Fuel depletion win/lose
101:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
102:   }
103: 
104:   function draw() {
105:     // clear
106:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
107:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
108: 
109:     // ship
110:     ctx.save();
111:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
112:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
113:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
114:     ctx.beginPath();
115:     ctx.moveTo(20, 0);
116:     ctx.lineTo(-10, -10);
117:     ctx.lineTo(-10, 10);
118:     ctx.closePath();
119:     ctx.fill();
120:     ctx.restore();
121: 
122:     // asteroids
123:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
124:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
125:       ctx.beginPath();
126:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
127:       ctx.fill();
128:     });
129: 
130:     // laser visual
131:     if (laser) {
132:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff0';
133:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
134:       ctx.beginPath();
135:       ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
136:       const lx = ship.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * 40;
137:       const ly = ship.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * 40;
138:       ctx.lineTo(lx, ly);
139:       ctx.stroke();
140:     }
141: 
142:     // UI – score, fuel
143:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
144:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
145:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
146:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.max(0, ship.fuel).toFixed(1)}`, 10, 40);
147: 
148:     if (gameOver) {
149:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
150:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
151:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
152:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
153:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
154:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
155:     }
156:   }
157: 
158:   let last = performance.now();
159:   function loop(now) {
160:     const dt = now - last;
161:     last = now;
162:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
163:     draw();
164:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
165:   }
166:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
167: })();
